label: Guide me: My return

params.name: lede
params.default: Your own return - ITR-1, 2, 3 or 4, for yourself or a family HUF. Start from your documents: {product} reads them, checks them against each other, works out both regimes and makes the department's JSON.
params.label: lede

default.title: Five steps
default.say: Gather, check, choose, review, file. Each step ticks itself off as it is done, and you can click any step to go back to it.

default.title: Start from documents
default.say: No client to add first. Drop the pre-filled JSON or a return already filed, and the person - or the HUF - is made from it: PAN, name, date of birth. A CA firm sees its people here; you go straight to your own return.

default.title: Keep these handy
default.say: A checklist of what to have before you start. Each line ticks itself when the document is in.

default.title: Where each document comes from
default.say: Who issues each document and what it gives your return: Form 16 from your employer; the AIS, TIS and 26AS from the department; a capital-gains statement from CAMS or your broker; your bank statement.

default.title: Drop in your documents
default.say: PDF, Excel, CSV or JSON: the pre-filled JSON, Form 16 from each employer, the AIS, TIS and 26AS, a CAMS or broker statement, a bank statement, last year's filed return.

default.title: Locked PDFs
default.say: An AIS or 26AS PDF opens with its password - your PAN in small letters and your date of birth. The eye shows what you typed.

default.title: What each one gave
default.say: Every document shows what was read from it - salary, tax deducted, interest, each sale - and, if you do not have it yet, how to get it. Drop the same kind again and you are asked first: replace it, or keep both. A second Form 16 from the same employer is asked about too - a revised one replaces the first; one from another employer is a job change, and both count.

default.title: History
default.say: Every figure you change and every document you replace is in History, with who and when. Old versions are kept, ready to download.

default.title: Your return at a glance
default.say: Total income, tax, and the refund due or the amount to pay - kept up to date with every document and every figure.

default.title: Do the documents agree?
default.say: Form 16's tax deducted beside 26AS, and salary and interest beside the AIS. Two employers in a year? Each took off the standard deduction - the return takes it once, and the check says so. A gap is shown to you before the department finds it.

default.title: New or old regime
default.say: Both regimes worked out in full, the cheaper one marked. Pick either - the other stays one click away.

default.title: From income to tax
default.say: Gross income, what is exempt, the deductions, the taxable income and the tax - step by step.

default.title: Salary
default.say: Each employer's figures from Form 16, with the source beside them. Type over anything - your own figure is marked as yours.

default.title: Residential status
default.say: Days in India this year and the years before decide resident, not ordinarily resident or non-resident - and so which income counts.

default.title: Salary arrears
default.say: Arrears for an earlier year: each year's income and regime, and the relief under section 89 worked out, with a reminder to file Form 10E - even for a year over fifty lakh, with that year's surcharge.

default.title: Income from outside India
default.say: Foreign salary, interest or rent, by country, with the tax paid there - relief under the treaty, or section 91 without one.

default.title: Foreign assets
default.say: A resident's bank accounts, shares and property abroad, accounts you can sign for, trusts and other income from outside India - for Schedule FA.

default.title: Clubbing
default.say: Your spouse's or minor child's income that the law adds to yours - with the exemption for each child.

default.title: House property
default.say: Self-occupied or let out, rent, municipal tax and loan interest. A co-owned house is taken by your share, and interest before the house was finished in five parts.

default.title: Business or profession
default.say: Presumptive income under 44AD, 44ADA or 44AE, or your own profit and loss. Receipts can come from your bank statement. Cash received and paid decide the tax-audit limit; left 44AD in the last five years, and it stays closed. GST turnover per GSTIN, typed or read from your GSTR-3B. The form follows: ITR-4, or ITR-3.

default.title: Other income
default.say: Savings and deposit interest, dividends, family pension - from the AIS, or typed.

default.title: Winnings and crypto
default.say: Lottery and online games, and crypto or other virtual digital assets - taxed at thirty percent, a crypto loss set off against nothing.

default.title: Tax you paid yourself
default.say: Advance tax and self-assessment tax, with the BSR code and challan number - or read from the AIS.

default.title: Capital gains
default.say: Every sale from a CAMS or broker statement, or typed: shares and funds with grandfathering, and a house or land with the cheaper of the two rates. Exemptions under 54, 54EC and 54F - more than one on a sale, each checked against its time limit. A CAMS or KFintech PDF is read too.

default.title: Losses brought forward
default.say: Losses from earlier years, set off this year and carried on - or filled from last year's filed ITR-2 or ITR-3.

default.title: Gifts
default.say: Gifts of money or property: from a relative or on your wedding they are free; from others, over fifty thousand in a year is income.

default.title: Deductions
default.say: 80C to 80G, and more for the old regime: 80DD, 80DDB, 80EE, 80EEA, 80EEB, 80GG and 80GGC, with the details each schedule asks for.

default.title: A few questions
default.say: Contact details for the return, farm income, and for an HUF the Karta who signs it.

default.title: Already filed?
default.say: Once filed, note the date and acknowledgement - and compare what was filed with what {product} worked out.

default.title: File it
default.say: Download the department's JSON for ITR-1, 2, 3 or 4, checked against its schema, and upload it on the e-filing portal.

default.title: Updated return
default.say: Missed something in an earlier year? The updated return, ITR-U: the extra tax, interest and the additional tax worked out at that year's rates - capital gains, surcharge and interest for each instalment - and whether you can file one at all.

description_nl: 2026-10-06: the My return walk - the five steps, the documents, the checks, the two regimes, the review and the file; tours/sf-myreturn.json says the same. 2026-10-07: rewritten for what shipped on 6-7 October (tools/make_guides_wave4.py).
